nodes.title: Airtime and Data
nodes.summary: This section provides an overview of the API suites for vending airtime and data, noting deductions from the SQUAD account.

nodes.title: API KEYS (Test Environment)
nodes.summary: This section explains how to obtain API keys and configure authorization for the test environment, including base URLs.

nodes.title: Vend Airtime
nodes.summary: This section details the API endpoint for vending airtime, including its parameters, responses, and a sample request.

nodes.title: POST /vending/purchase/airtime
nodes.summary: This endpoint processes requests to vend airtime, requiring a phone number and amount, and provides various response examples.

nodes.title: Vend Data Bundles
nodes.summary: This section details the API endpoint for vending data bundles, including its parameters, responses, and a sample request.

nodes.title: POST /vending/purchase/data
nodes.summary: This endpoint handles requests for purchasing data bundles, requiring a phone number and a plan code, and provides response details.

nodes.title: Get Data Bundles
nodes.summary: This section describes the API endpoint to retrieve all available data bundle plans, including parameters and detailed responses.

nodes.title: GET /vending/data-bundles
nodes.summary: This endpoint provides a list of all available data bundle plans, filterable by network, with success and error response structures.

nodes.title: Retrieve Airtime and Data Transactions
nodes.summary: This section details the API endpoint for retrieving airtime and data transactions, allowing multiple filters for specific queries.

nodes.title: GET /vending/transactions
nodes.summary: This endpoint allows merchants to retrieve a filtered list of their airtime and data transactions based on criteria like page, action, and reference.

nodes.title: Going Live
nodes.summary: This section outlines the necessary steps to transition from the sandbox environment to the live production environment, including KYC and API key changes.
